deadline.value: The fall PhD deadline is December 7 (year inferred); later applications are accepted on a rolling basis.
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply for the fall semester is December 7.

fee_waiver.value: BME has no waiver funds; waivers exist only for applicants who engage with College of Engineering outreach or recruitment programming.
fee_waiver.quote: BME does not have funds for Application Fee Waivers.

also.quote: Application fee waivers are available for prospective students who engage with the Center for Engineering Outreach & Inclusion or central College of Engineering graduate recruitment programming.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for admission.
gre_general.quote: Scores from the Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) are not required for admission.

supervisor.value: Faculty make the admission offers for their own labs, and applicants are told to contact and interview with faculty.
supervisor.quote: All decisions on admission offers will be made by individual faculty for applicant recruitment into their lab.

funding.value: All applicants are considered for assistantships and fellowships; support is not stated as automatic.
funding.quote: All applicants are considered for research or teaching assistantships and applicable fellowships.
